notes: A gate node with kind gate and status running while gates/approve.request.yml does not exist: the model is about to end the turn without ever asking the operator. The nudge blocks and the reason tells it to write the request file (temp + rename), set gate_pending, rewrite dashboard-data.js, print GATE-PENDING and stop. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
